Dan Barrios

Democratic candidate for U.S. Representative, District 32, Dallas County, Texas · Open seat

Former Richardson City Council member; former teacher (listed by BallotReady as an adjunct professor at Trinity Valley Community College)

Dan Barrios is a Democrat who served on the Richardson City Council (Place 3) after being elected in May 2023. He grew up in Brownsville and has lived in North Texas for more than 25 years. He announced his run for the open TX-32 seat in December, won the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary over Anthony Bridges with 60.1% of the vote, and resigned from the council in July to campaign full-time.

Where Barrios stands

Cost of living / affordability
Calls affordability the district's biggest challenge and names housing, health care, education and the cost of raising children as his top concerns.
Health care
Lists insurance premiums, prescription drug costs and keeping rural hospitals open as his health care priorities.
Education and workforce
Supports investing in education and workforce development.
Economy / small business
Says he is focused on strengthening families, supporting small businesses and expanding opportunity.
